description: Investigate and completely fix Codex Desktop so coding from the desktop application works, not only from the terminal. It currently reports: Error al crear el chat; error creating thread: Fatal error: Failed to initialize session: required MCP servers failed to initialize: harness-aci: handshaking with MCP server failed: connection closed: initialize response. Determine whether harness-aci works in the terminal and make every necessary change to resolve the problem.
acceptance_criteria: Codex Desktop can initialize the required harness-aci MCP server when the application process was not launched from the repository root.
The harness-aci launcher remains portable and does not depend on a short-lived fnm multishell path.
The MCP server completes a legacy initialize handshake and exposes its tool catalog through the configured Codex launch path.
Focused regression tests reproduce the former Desktop launch failure and pass after the fix.
Relevant deterministic ACI tests pass and the final diff preserves unrelated in-progress user changes.
